articleTitle: Widely wavelength tunable hybrid III–V/silicon laser with 45 nm tuning range fabricated using a wafer bonding technique
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: A hybrid III–V on silicon laser, integrating two intra-cavity ring resonators, is fabricated by using a wafer bonding technique. It achieves a thermal tuning range of 45 nm, with side mode suppression ratio higher than 40 dB.

articleTitle: 25 Gb/s silicon photonic transceivers
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We report on the demonstration of an integrated 4×25 Gb/s parallel optical transceiver built in Luxtera's CMOS photonics platform, and discuss how we can scale this platform to even higher data rates.

articleTitle: 40 Gb/s thermally tunable CMOS ring modulator
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We report a high-contrast 40Gb/s ring modulator with integrated thermal tuning fabricated in a 130nm CMOS process. Under 2V modulation, its optical eyes showed extinction ratios of 7dB at 40Gb/s and 2.3dB at 44Gb/s.

articleTitle: 50-Gb/s silicon modulator using 250-µm-Long phase shifter based-on forward-biased pin diodes
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We present a 50-Gb/s silicon Mach-Zehnder modulator that uses the shortest 250-μm long phase shifter. A 4.2-dB extinction ratio was obtained at 50 Gb/s with 4.35 V peak-to-peak (V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">pp</sub>) driving signals and 45-mW power consumption.

articleTitle: Lithography simulation for the fabrication of silicon photonic devices with deep-ultraviolet lithography
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We demonstrate the lithography simulation for the fabrication of silicon photonic devices using deep-ultraviolet lithography. Once the distortions arising from the fabrication process are accounted for, the comparison between predicted and measured results is excellent.

articleTitle: High linear ring-assisted MZI electro-optic silicon modulators suitable for radio-over-fiber applications
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: The linearity properties of ring-assisted MZI (RAMZI) electro-optic silicon modulators are investigated. When quadrature biased the RAMZI silicon modulator with V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">bias,DC</sub>=1 V and applied a 1 GHz RF tone frequency, it is obtained a Spurious-Free Dynamic Range (SFDR) of 71.65 dB·Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2/3</sup>, and an input intercept point IIP3=67 dBm. Measurements on QPSK and 16-QAM electrical modulated signals on a 1 GHz carrier also show an experimental error vector magnitude (EVM) lower than 10% and 14% for 20 Msymbol/s and 50 Msymbol/s modulation rates respectively, which corroborates their potential for RoF applications.

articleTitle: A novel spot size convertor for hybrid integrated light sources on photonics-electronics convergence system
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We have developed a spot size converter (SSC) with a trident silicon (Si) waveguide for the hybrid integrated light source in a photonics-electronics convergence system. Low loss coupling was achieved with just the simple planar form of a Si waveguide with no use of complicated structures such as vertical tapers or extra dielectric core overlaid on the waveguide. The coupling loss was 2.3 dB and the tolerance of misalignment up to a 1-dB loss increase was about ± 0.9 μm. We also confirmed that the coupling efficiency was quite robust against manufacturing fluctuations of the waveguide width compared with a conventional SSC with an inverse taper waveguide. We were able to fabricate a 52-channel light source with highly uniform output power by using the proposed trident SSC.

articleTitle: CMOS-compatible Tungsten heaters for silicon photonic waveguides
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We present a Tungsten thermo-optic tuner on SOI, using standard CMOS back-end fabrication processes. Tuning efficiency of 35.2mW/FSR was achieved on ring resonators with 10%-90% heating time of 2.8μs.

articleTitle: Is there a need for on-chip photonic integration for large data warehouse switches
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Over the past 18-months VCSEL based optical engines have been integrated into package of large-scale HPC routers, moderate size Ethernet switches, and even FPGA's. Competing solutions based on Silicon Photonics (SiP) are emerging and targeting similar application space but with better integration path through the use of TSV (Through Silicon Via) stack dies. Integrating either VCSEL or SiP based optical engines into complex IC package that operate at high temperatures and require high reliability is not trivial, and one should ask what is the technical or the economic advantage before embarking on such a drastic architectural change. We are currently investigating the extend to which scenarios on-chip photonic integration into large-scale data warehouse switches have clear power and/or bandwidth advantages over using traditional electrical I/O.

articleTitle: Full area emitter SiGe phototransistor for opto-microwave circuit applications
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We present a study of full area emitter phototransistors with different optical window sizes implemented in a SiGe Bipolar technology. Extracted responsivity of 3.5 A/W and an opto-microwave cut-off frequency of 739 MHz were observed.

articleTitle: A highly efficient electrically pumped optical amplifier integrated on a SOI waveguide circuit
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: A heterogeneously integrated III-V-on-silicon optical amplifier utilizing an ultra-thin DVS-BCB die-to-wafer bonding process is reported. A novel design exploiting high confinement in the active waveguide is demonstrated showing low power consumption operation. 13dB on-chip gain is achieved for 40mA drive current at room temperature.

articleTitle: Ultralow-loss silicon ring resonators
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate silicon ring resonators with internal quality factors of Q<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>=2.2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup>, corresponding to record 2.7-dB/m losses. We show that the losses are bend-loss-limited, indicating that the loss limit for silicon has not been reached.

articleTitle: Silicon photonics for optical access networks
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We highlight promising developments and directions in silicon photonics for realizing cost effective WDM-PON: photonic integration for integrated WDM transceivers at the OLT and widely tunable laser technologies for achieving a high performance, colorless ONU.

articleTitle: IPKISS: A parametric design and simulation framework for silicon photonics
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We present IPKISS, an open-source design environment for complex (silicon) photonic circuitry. The tool set allows flexible mask design, direct electromagnetic simulation and circuit models, and can be easily interfaced with existing tools.

articleTitle: Narrow spectral linewidth wavelength tunable laser with Si photonic-wire waveguide ring resonators
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We fabricated wavelength tunable laser diodes with Si-wire waveguide ring resonators as an external optical cavity. Less than 100 kHz narrow spectral linewidth was obtained by optimizing design of the ring resonators. The wavelength tunable laser diodes with narrow spectral linewidth are suitable as light sources for digital coherent optical transmission systems.

articleTitle: Circuit-switched on-chip photonic interconnection network
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel circuit-switched on-chip photonic interconnection network (CSPIN) architecture. Different from existing circuit-switched photonic networks, CSPIN eliminates the electronic control layer but employs optical signaling to control the circuit switching functions. To implement CSPIN, the CSPIN router is proposed which uses electro-optical tuned micro-ring resonators. The analysis based on the synthesis result of the CSPIN router shows that significant savings in power and path-setup latency are achieved by the proposed CSPIN architecture.

articleTitle: High-efficiency hybrid III–V/Si external cavity DBR laser for 3-µm SOI waveguides
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We report a 9.5% wall-plug-efficient un-cooled external-cavity DBR laser built with a III-V-semiconductor reflective-SOA edge-coupled to an SOI waveguide containing a Bragg grating mirror. The hybrid laser is suitable for power efficient, CMOS-compatible optical transmitters.

articleTitle: A temperature sensor based on silicon eye-like microring with sharp asymmetric fano resonance
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: A high sensitivity photonic temperature sensor based on silicon eye-like microring resonator system (EMRS) is reported. The results show great enhancement of the sensing performance by using the EMRS configuration.

articleTitle: Silicon multi-project wafer platforms for optoelectronic system integration
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We report on several multi-project wafer (MPW) platforms for optoelectronic systems, which support monolithic integration of modulators and detectors at 25 Gb/s or higher. We also describe the Luxtera platform, which includes CMOS integration.

articleTitle: 250 Gbps 10-channel WDM silicon photonics receiver
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: An ultra-compact 10-wavelength WDM echelle grating receiver is demonstrated with 250 Gbps data receiving capability on a footprint of 0.96 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. Less than 1 dB channel-to-channel sensitivity variation is obtained at 25 Gbps.

articleTitle: Electrically tunable resonant filters in phase-shifted contra-directional couplers
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We demonstrate an electrically tunable resonant filter with FSR-free operation using a silicon photonic quarter-wavelength phase-shifted, grating-assisted contra-directional coupler. The spectrum shows a stop-band of 7nm, an extinction of 24dB, and a Q of 7,000.

articleTitle: On-chip wavelength-routed photonic networks with comb switches
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: In this paper we propose to use comb switches to simplify Banyan-type on-chip wavelength-routed passive photonic networks constructed by micro-ring resonator (MRR)-based optical switches. Compared with general wavelength-routed optical networks, the number of MRRs used in the simplified network is significantly reduced.

articleTitle: Single-band add-drop filters using anti-reflection, contra-directional couplers
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We demonstrate a wide-bandwidth add-drop filter using silicon contra-directional couplers with a novel anti-reflection design. Single-band operation, with a bandwidth of 6.5nm and an extinction ratio of over 20dB, has been experimentally obtained.

articleTitle: Performance of parallel 4×25 Gbs transmitter and receiver fabricated on SOI platform
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We demonstrate performance of Ge-Si optical modulator and Ge PD receiver on a SOI platform for the parallel 4×25 Gbs application.

articleTitle: High-speed avalanche photodiodes using III–V nanopillars monolithically grown on silicon
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We demonstrate III-V avalanche photodiodes monolithically integrated onto silicon by CMOS-compatible growth. With bandwidth exceeding 3 GHz and gain as high as 28, nanopillar devices showcase the viability of bottom-up III-V nanomaterials for high-performance optoelectronics.

articleTitle: 16 channel receiver with 20 GHz Ge photodiodes
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: A 200GHz 16 channel receiver with polarization management was obtained with a 2D grating coupler, 2xAWGs and 16 Ge photodiodes. PDL was below 1dB, BW above 20GHz, receiver sensitivity in the order of 0.08 A/W.

articleTitle: Bragg grating based Fabry-Perot filters for characterizing silicon-on-insulator waveguides
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Bragg grating based Fabry-Perot filters implemented on a submicron silicon waveguide and providing sub-GHz transmission notches are used to characterize the waveguide effective index, group index and propagation loss.

articleTitle: Epitaxial III–V-on-silicon waveguide butt-coupled photodetectors
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We demonstrate butt-coupled p-i-n InGaAs photodetectors epitaxially grown on silicon substrates by MOCVD. We measure a dark current of 8 nA upon -1V and open eye-diagrams at 15Gb/s upon -3V and at 20Gb/s upon -5V.

articleTitle: Hybrid integration of coherent receivers for Terabit Ethernet on SOI waveguide PLC
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We present a new coherent receiver platform integrating low-loss SOI PLC technology with high-speed vertically illuminated InGaAs photodiodes. Performance & ease of assembly make this an attractive candidate for Tb/s Ethernet.

articleTitle: Lateral carrier injection to germanium for monolithic light sources
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We propose lateral carrier injections into a Ge waveguide on a silicon-on-insulator diode for monolithic light sources. We confirmed enhanced electroluminescence from the diode under high current densities of 1 MAcm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>.

articleTitle: Integrated silicon photonic temperature sensors based on bragg reflectors with asymmetric fano lineshapes
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We investigate theoretically and experimentally temperature sensors based on asymmetric Fano resonances in integrated silicon Bragg reflectors. A temperature sensitivity of 77pm/°C can be achieved due to thermo-optic effect of silicon.

articleTitle: Low mode volume slotted photonic crystal single nanobeam cavity in silicon
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We demonstrate a low mode volume slotted photonic crystal single nanobeam cavity in silicon. Ultra-small effective mode volumes, ~0.025(λ/n)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, an order of magnitude smaller than traditional nanobeam cavities, are achieved while maintaining Q-factors near 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>.

articleTitle: Low-loss low-crosstalk silicon rib waveguide crossing with tapered multimode-interference design
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We report the design and fabrication of silicon rib-waveguide crossings based on taper-integrated multimode-interference. Measured devices built in a 130nm SOI CMOS process showed an insertion loss of 0.1dB/crossing, and an extracted crosstalk below -35dB.

articleTitle: Electroluminescence of unstrained and tensile strained Ge-on-Si LEDs
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: The strain of MBE grown Ge-on-Si p-i-n diodes is engineered between zero and 0.24% tensile strain. From electroluminescence peak positions the direct bandgap energies are determined to vary between 0.801 eV and 0.782 eV respectively.

articleTitle: 12.5 Gb/s carrier-injection silicon Mach-Zehnder optical modulator with high optical bandwidth
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We demonstrate a carrier-injection silicon Mach-Zehnder optical modulator with high optical bandwidth by adopting two symmetric arms. The dynamic extinction ratio at the speed of 12.5 Gb/s is 7.0 ~ 8.9 dB in the wavelength range from 1525 nm to 1565 nm. The phase shifter is only 100 μm and the figure of merit V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</sub>·L is 0.0155 V·cm.

articleTitle: Time-Of-Flight range finding sensor using an integrated PNP PIN Phototransistor in 180 nm CMOS
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: In this work we present the first approach of a Time-Of-Flight (TOF) sensor with an integrated bandwidth enhanced pnp phototransistor. The pixel reaches a fill factor of 67 %. A standard 180 nm CMOS process was used for implementing the TOF sensor together with the phototransistor. Both were combined to an optoelectronic integrated circuit. The power consumption of the sensor was 900 nW. Standard deviations of the measured distances well better than 5.1 cm were achieved for realistic optical powers in the range of nW. For the optimal working point of the phototransistor at around 100 nW a standard deviation of only 1.6 mm was measured.

articleTitle: Low drive voltage 10 Gb/s and high contrast 40 Gb/s silicon slow wave modulators
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We demonstrate the use of slow light to reduce the drive voltage and shrink the footprint of carrier depletion-based silicon modulators. Hence, low drive voltage 10 Gb/s modulation and high contrast 40Gb/s modulation is achieved.

articleTitle: Mach-Zehnder based 2×2 electro-optical switches on silicon-on-insulator with low crosstalk
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We report the demonstrations of two Mach-Zehnder based 2 × 2 electro-optical switches with low crosstalk. One is with assist of variable optical attenuator and the other is based on cascaded Mach-Zehnder interferometer.

articleTitle: Time-resolved photoluminescence study of highly n-doped germanium grown on silicon
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We report on the photoluminescence dynamics of highly n-doped tensile-strained germanium on silicon. The instantaneous decay photoluminescence lifetime changes with intensity, which is explained by the interplay of Shockley-Read Hall and Auger processes.

articleTitle: Measurement of nonreciprocal stimulated Raman scattering in silicon photonic wires
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Nonreciprocal stimulated Raman scattering in a silicon waveguide is shown experimentally for the first time: the measured backward-to-forward transmission ratio is enhanced when a probe laser is tuned to the Stokes wavelength.

articleTitle: Wavelength-tuning-free 10-Gb/s operation of a silicon-integrated resonantly-enhanced modulator and single-mode laser
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: A modulator with an enhanced efficiency by cascaded microring resonators (MRRs), and a single-mode laser with a wavelength determined by a MRR wavelength filter were integrated on a Si chip to demonstrate for the first time wavelength-tuning-free 10-Gb/s modulation over a wide range of temperature.

articleTitle: Self-aligned microbonded Ge/Si PIN waveguide photodetectors
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: A cost-effective process using self-aligned microbonded Ge-beams on silicon waveguides is presented. Heterojunction photodetectors featuring low dark-current of 0.7uA (-2V) and high turn-on current of 10.8 mA (+3V) are demonstrated. The operation bandwidth is 11-16GHz.

articleTitle: Silicon/silica-hybrid delay line interferometer for DPSK demodulation
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: A 1-bit delay line interferometer based on silicon/silica-hybrid waveguides is demonstrated for a differential phase-shift keying (DPSK) demodulator. A 10-Gb/s NRZ-DPSK signal is demodulated with error-free operation in telecommunications bands.

articleTitle: 12.6 Gb/s direct OFDM modulation of a hybrid III–V-on-silicon laser
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: The high-order Quadrature Amplitude Modulation (QAM) of a III–V-on-Silicon laser is achieved for the first time, through Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM), allowing a 12.6Gb/s-transmission with a 4GHz-bandwidth.

articleTitle: Transfer printed photonic crystal nanomembrane lasers on silicon with low optical pumping threshold
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We report here an ultra-compact membrane lasers on silicon with very low pumping threshold. The laser consists of InGaAsP QW active region sandwiched in between two single-layer Fano resonance silicon photonic crystal nanomembrane reflectors, based on transfer printing technique.

articleTitle: High efficiency grating coupler for 3 µm SOI waveguides
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We demonstrate a grating coupler for use on a 3 μm device layer SOI platform by employing a two-stage taper. Our measured radiation efficiency is 75% and simulations show output as high as 86%.

articleTitle: Germanium laser: A CMOS compatible light emitter
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: CMOS Ge-on-Si pnn multimode laser diode is demonstrated. Calculated losses suggest a gain above 100cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>. Observed power of above 1mW is reported.

articleTitle: Future photonics convergence on Si
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: In the near future, photonics will complement Si CMOS technologies in high performance emerging applications. This convergence has been possible thanks to the compatibility with Si processes, which will be beneficial to applications such as optical interconnect, lighting, display and medicine.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared photonic crystal waveguides in SOI
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We demonstrate the design, fabrication and characterization of mid-infrared photonic crystal waveguides on a silicon-on-insulator platform, showing guided modes in the wavelength regime between 2.9 and 3.9 μm.

articleTitle: Toward an integrated silicon-photonic module for widely tunable narrow-line RF source using injection-locking
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Through the use of a narrow-linewidth low-frequency oscillator, optical modulator, and injection locking, we have developed a system for generating widely tunable, narrow-line RF signals from a pair of injection-locked lasers. Here we focus on the design and implementation of an integrated device including photonic sources and modulators to realize the system described above. Specifically, we report on the creation and mixing of two tunable lasers on a silicon platform with a heterogeneously integrated gain medium realized in a III-V material system.

articleTitle: High-uniformity waveguide-integrated metal-semiconductor-metal germanium photodetector with sige capping layer and its application to differential receivers
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Differential pairs of metal-semiconductor-metal (MSM) germanium (Ge) photodetectors (PDs) with an epitaxially-tuned silicon germanium (SiGe) capping layer are fabricated. PDs with high responsivity (1.0 A/W) and low dark current (33 mA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) are obtained, and low-noise characteristics and 10 Gbps data transmission is confirmed in the differential MSM PDs.

articleTitle: Accurate post-fabrication trimming of silicon resonators
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an accurate high-throughput post-fabrication trimming technique for silicon-based photonic devices using a single fabrication step. Using this technique, we reduce the random resonance wavelength variation of ultra-compact silicon resonators by a factor of six.

articleTitle: Suppression of scattering loss in Erbium-Yttrium Silicate crystalline waveguide fabricated by radical-assisted sputtering
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Er<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.45</sub>Y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1.55</sub>SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub> crystalline waveguide burying Si-guide stripe was fabricated by radical-assisted sputtering (RAS). We evaluated the light propagation properties with pumping at 1.48m. The light propagation loss drastically decreases by 82 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> in the RAS waveguide compared with the previous waveguide by sol-gel.

articleTitle: Object-oriented modified photometric stereo algorithm for 3D imaging in fiber-to-chip coupling
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: An object-oriented modified photometric stereo algorithm (OO-MPSA) is proposed for 3D imaging during fiber coupling with silica-on-silicon (SoS) chips, which can be constructed by three 2D graphics.

articleTitle: Improvement of SiGe MOS interfaces by plasma post-nitridation for SiGe high-k MOS optical modulators
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Plasma post-nitridation process was investigated to improve SiGe MOS interfaces for high-k MOS optical modulators. The interface trap density was reduced by an order of magnitude by nitridation, which can contribute to enhance modulation efficiency.

articleTitle: Hybrid Si3N4-Er/Yb/Y silicate waveguide amplifier with 1.25dB/cm internal gain
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We first fabricated the hybrid Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>-Er/Yb/Y silicate waveguide amplifiers, and the internal gain of 1.25dB/cm with gain bandwidth of 20nm was observed using 1476nm pumping.

articleTitle: High speed electro-absorption modulator based on quantum-confined stark effect from Ge/SiGe multiple quantum wells
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: A 90 μm long 23 GHz Ge/SiGe modulator using the QCSE in waveguide configuration was demonstrated with an ER higher than 10 dB for a wide spectral range. Energy consumption was only 108 fJ/bit.

articleTitle: 1.53µm electroluminescence of erbium excited by hot carriers in ErRE (RE=Yb, Y) silicates
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We investigated the 1.53μm electroluminescence of erbium excited by hot carriers in ErRE (RE=Yb, Y) silicate metal-insulator-silicon light emitting devices. Intense 1.53μm light emissions and large Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> impact excitation cross sections were obtained.

articleTitle: Real-time analysis of antigen-antibody association kinetics using a low-cost SOI photonic biosensor
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We present an analysis of the association kinetics of the BSA-antiBSA (antigen-antibody) complex by using a photonic bandgap biosensor. The readout of the biosensor is done using a real-time and low-cost power-based technique.

articleTitle: An alignment tolerant high speed ring resonator based silicon optical modulator
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Optical modulation up to 40Gbit/s from a silicon ring resonator based device is demonstrated. A self-aligned process is used to form the pn junction reducing performance variations. The power consumption of the device is 8fJ/bit.

articleTitle: Comb-laser driven WDM for short reach silicon photonic based optical interconnection
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We describe an InAs/GaAs quantum dot laser used in conjunction with an SOI ring resonator modulation scheme to provide mutli-wavelength transmission for optical interconnects. The current proposed co-packaging solution may be extended using bonding technology.

articleTitle: Submicron silicon waveguides and optical splitters for mid-infrared applications
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We report on the design, fabrication and characterisation of submicron silicon-on-insulator strip waveguides at a 3.74 μm wavelength. Experimental results for 1×2 multi-mode interference splitters are also given.

articleTitle: Propagation of lossy wave in Si slot waveguide
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: In order to realize the Si based optical waveguide, which can propagate the absorption wavelength in Si, we theoretically and experimentally investigate the material propagation loss of silicon-on-insulator slot waveguide at 1050 nm.

articleTitle: Lateral PIN current-injected photonic crystal nanocavity light emitting diodes based on Ge quantum dots
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Current-injected light emitting diodes based on Ge quantum dots in photonic crystal nanocavities are demonstrated by using lateral PIN diode structure. A sharp resonant peak with Q-factor of 1560 is obtained in the electroluminescence spectrum.

articleTitle: Spatially resolved measurement of free-carrier absorption in silicon waveguides
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Spatially resolved measurement of free-carrier absorption in silicon nanophotonic waveguides using optical frequency-domain reflectometry is reported. Our measurement technique yields the local attenuation that is added by a strong continous-wave pump laser.

articleTitle: Robust 4-channel WDM demultiplexing filter based on collectively tuned silicon microrings
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We demonstrate a robust 4-channel WDM demultiplexing filter based on cascaded silicon microring resonators. A comparison is made between first- and second-order filters regarding the robustness of the filter response to wafer-scale fabrication variations.

articleTitle: A uniform, low loss 1×16 power splitter based on a high Q Si3N4 ring resonator
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: A novel ring resonator based 1×16 optical power splitter is demonstrated on Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> waveguides with excellent uniformity (0.4dB) and low excess loss (0.9dB). The device is promising for high port count splitters without cascading.

articleTitle: Compact broadband directional coupler
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Directional couplers are key building blocks for network-on-chip devices such as wavelength demultiplexers and switches. The operational bandwidth of directional couplers is, however, limited, and existing techniques to extend their bandwidth result in significantly increased device footprints and degraded phase response. Here we present a novel approach to enhance the bandwidth of directional couplers without affecting their size or phase response. Using dispersion engineering of sub-wavelength gratings we show by 3D FDTD simulations a fivefold increase in coupler bandwidth from 20nm to 100 nm.

articleTitle: Monolithic suspended membrane ring resonator for mid-infrared applications
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We proposed a monolithic suspended membrane ring (SMR) resonator with focusing subwavelength grating for mid-infrared applications. The SMR with Q of ~10000 and extinction ratio of ~13 dB was measured in near-infrared.

articleTitle: GeSn light-emitting pin diodes on Si
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: GeSn LED's exhibit light emission from the direct band transition. The emission wavelength is red shifted compared to Ge. The redshift of the direct band transition is confirmed by different optical characterization techniques.

articleTitle: 44Gbit/s silicon Mach-Zehnder modulator based on interleaved PN junctions
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We report a 44 Gbit/s silicon Mach-Zehnder modulator based on interleaved PN junctions. Modulation efficiency of V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</sub>L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</sub>=1.5~2.0 V·cm and carrier induced loss of ~1dB/mm are obtained with a moderate doping density of 2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">17</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>.

articleTitle: Si waveguide wavelength filters using high-order-mode selection by waveguide coupler
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We report wavelength filter using coupled Si waveguides and its high order mode. The wavelength dispersion difference between modes can be used to construct an add/drop wavelength filter. Devices incorporating reflective mode conversion grating and slot/twin waveguide are reported.

articleTitle: Low-power-consumption, high speed Mach-Zehnder silicon optical modulator for CMOS compatible integration
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We demonstrate a 2-mm-long carrier-depletion modulator which can work at a speed of 40 Gbps under a differential voltage of 0.36 V with no reverse bias. The power efficiency could be 49 fJ/bit.

articleTitle: Highly efficient coupling between a nanocavity and monolithic bus waveguide
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a new SOI based optical filter design comprising of a photonic crystal cavity and a low index bus waveguide and realise high extinction ratios and low insertion losses.

articleTitle: Gain-assisted hybrid silicon microring electro-absorption modulators
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Energy consumption and device footprint are major limiting factors in scaling current optical interconnect architectures to reach multi-terabit per second data transmission. Hybrid integration of III-V on Si using a low-temperature O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> plasma-assisted wafer bonding technique is an attractive platform for integrating active elements on Si in a low optical loss and high density manner. Further scaling on individual devices could enable hybrid photonic integrated circuits with complex functionality and low power consumption. A microring resonator is widely regarded as an ideal structure for very compact passive and active devices, e.g., recently demonstrated hybrid Si microring lasers [3]. Although microring structures are wavelength sensitive, they have several advantages viz. small size, resonance-enhanced efficiency and no intrinsic reflections. We propose a novel microring modulator design by incorporating a gain and a loss section in the same microring cavity. Separately biasing the two sections best uses the properties of a microring resonator. We compare this design with two other techniques that were previously employed on III-V-based electro-absorption (EA) microring modulators. We also show the promise of the design in achieving high efficiency modulation with respect to some state of the art Si ring modulator results.

articleTitle: Silicon-based photonic ring resonators for optical OFDM demultiplexing
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We propose a compact integrated OOFDM demultiplexer based on silicon-based photonic ring resonators, providing cost-effective solution and low energy consumption. 160-Gb/s OOFDM demultiplexing operation is validated, showing excellent BER performance with error-free operation.

articleTitle: High efficiency CW four-wave mixing at 1.5 µm in SOI nano-rib waveguides using p-i-n diodes
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: In this paper we show FWM based parametric wavelength conversion with efficiency of -1 dB in reverse biased p-i-n diode assisted SOI waveguides. Structures have been fabricated in the 0.25 μm BiCMOS technology.

articleTitle: Si-wire MZI optical isolator fabricated by direct bonding
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: An optical isolator based on Si-wire Mach-Zehnder interferometer is demonstrated using direct bonding of Ce:YIG on it. Large magneto-optic phase shift and optical isolation of 18 dB is obtained at a wavelength of 1322 nm.

articleTitle: Miniaturized laser Doppler vibrometers integrated on silicon-on-insulator with thermo-optic serrodyne optical frequency shifter
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: A miniaturized heterodyne laser Doppler vibrometer integrated on silicon-on-insulator is reported and compared with a commercial LDV. The optical frequency shift was realized by applying the serrodyne method on a thermo-optic phase modulator.

articleTitle: Improvement of photoluminescence from Ge Layers with Si3N4/SiO2 Stressors
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: The photoluminescence from Ge stripes increased due to the large amount of tensile strain created by Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>/SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> stressors. The low temperature deposition of Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> was also effective at improving the optical properties of the Ge layer.

articleTitle: Low temperature crystallization of highly textured GeSn thin films on SiO2 for 3D photonic integration
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We report a highly (111)-textured Ge<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.9</sub>Sn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.1</sub> thin film fabricated on SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> at 464°C. Incorporating Sn into Ge significantly reduces the crystallization temperature and red-shifts the direct band gap to ~0.5 eV, approaching indirect-to-direct gap transition.

articleTitle: A CMOS compatible metallised nanofocusing coupler
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Transmission coupling efficiency in a CMOS compatible metallised nanofocusing coupler is investigated using finite element and transfer matrix simulations. Structural optimisation and coupling performances into an silicon-on-insulator and two nano-slot plasmonic waveguides are presented.

articleTitle: Double resonance 1-D glass-on-silicon photonic crystal cavities for single-molecule mid-infrared photothermal spectroscopy: Theory and design
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We propose a mid-infrared spectroscopic technique capable of detecting a single small molecule without using cryogenically cooled detectors. Such record sensitivity is attained by leveraging dramatically amplified photothermal effects in a pump-probe doubly resonant cavity.

articleTitle: Ferroelectric properties of PZT and PLZT films on Si substrate with ITO buffer layer
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: PZT and PLZT films on Si substrates were deposited to realize electro-optic modulators on LSI chip. The coercive field and remnant polarization of PZT and PLZT film were 148kV/cm and 50μC/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, 170kV/cm and 32μC/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, respectively.

articleTitle: Gas cluster ion beam treatment for silicon waveguide trimming
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We propose a gas cluster ion beam treatment for silicon waveguide trimming and demonstrated this treatment can effectively trim the silicon waveguides. This GCIB method is promising to trim resonators for a designed add/drop wavelength.

articleTitle: Numerical analysis of strained SiGe-based carrier-injection optical modulators
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Strain effect on SiGe-based carrier-injection optical modulators is numerically investigated. Owing to enhancement in free-carrier absorption of strained SiGe, SiGe-based pin-junction optical modulator is predicted to exhibit the 4.7× enhancement of free-carrier absorption against Si.

articleTitle: Temperature dependence of Ge quantum well light emitting diode on Si substrate
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We present the Ge/SiGe quantum well structure as a candidate for CMOS compatible light source. Thermal enhancement of electroluminescence from temperature dependent measurements agree with theory and indicates promise for an efficient Ge light source.

articleTitle: Ultra-low-loss silicon based spot-size converter fabricated by CMOS compatible process
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: An ultra-low-loss silicon based spot-size converter with an ultimate inverse-tapered waveguide was fabricated using a double-patterning photolithography technique. The measured mode conversion losses were 0.35±0.05 and 0.21±0.01 dB for the TE- and TM-like modes, respectively.

articleTitle: Capacitance of carrier depletion silicon-on-insulator optical modulation diodes
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: An analytical model for the capacitance of silicon-on-insulator optical modulation diodes is derived. Fringe capacitance can increase power consumption (~18%) and reduce f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3dB</sub> (~8GHz). Suppression of fringe fields can lead to speed and efficiency improvement.

articleTitle: GHz response of Si photodiodes fabricated with 0.35-µm Si BiCMOS technology
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We fabricated Si photodiode from 0.35 μm BiCMOS process and measured the sensitivity and the frequency response at the wavelength of 650nm. The responsivity was 0.11 A/W and the bandwidth was about 1 GHz.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation of large-scale photonic integrated circuits including radiation
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We present a rigorous circuit model for simulation of large-scale photonic integrated circuit in which both guided and radiation fields are taken into consideration. This model is more flexible, efficient, and scalable in comparison with the existing techniques.

articleTitle: Low-loss and high extinction ratio 40 Gbit/s optical modulator with self-aligned fabrication process
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Experimental results of a silicon modulator based on carrier depletion in a PIPIN diode integrated in a Mach-Zehnder interferometer, are presented. At 40 Gbit/s, the modulator exhibits 6.6 dB extinction ratio and 6 dB optical loss.

articleTitle: High-fidelity photonic building blocks fabricated using thermal nanoimprint lithography (T-NIL)
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We demonstrate high-fidelity photonic patterns, feature sizes (80nm to 3μm), using T-NIL. Appropriate CAD file design allows complete elimination of residual layer. Our fabricated ultra-compact microdisk resonators show similar quality factors to e-beam written samples.

articleTitle: Silicon-on-insulator 100µm-core multimode interferometer waveguides for two-dimensional microparticle trapping and manipulation
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We adapt silicon-on-insulator 100μm-core multimode interferometer waveguides for two-dimensional microparticle trapping and manipulation. The waveguide mode fields in 1550nm wavelengths enable thermal flow assisted optical manipulation of 2.2μm polystyrene microparticles in a thin fluidic cell.

articleTitle: Narrow gap width induced radiation loss on waveguide coupled microring
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We have carried out a detailed study of gap induced radiation loss effect in a micro-ring resonator. Our data show that small-gap induced loss dominates the total ring loss as the gap is less than 225 nm for TM mode.

articleTitle: Improvement in leakage characteristics of Ge-on-Si photodetectors
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Germanium (Ge) offers a distinct advantage over silicon (Si) in terms of its superior electron and hole mobility. In addition, its small direct bandgap of 0.8 eV at room temperature makes it possible to design efficient photodetectors operating in the low-loss optical fiber range of 1.3-1.6 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. Silicon, on the other hand, is a well established material for integrated circuits and has superior mechanical and thermal characteristics. The origin of dark currents in Ge-on-Si photodetectors is primarily due to the high density of threading dislocations (TDD) associated with the 4.2% lattice mismatch between Si and Ge. Most of the solutions to date for reducing dark currents have focused on the substrate/Ge film interface. Annealing and the use of SiGe buffer layers has been shown to be effective in the reduction of dark current in Ge-on-Si photodiodes. Dark currents between 296°K and 400°K have been shown to be associated with defect-related generation centers close to half the band gap energy of Ge, indicating prevalence of the Shockley-Read-Hall process. However, the measured dark current is the superposition of current contributions from three regions: bulk, depletion and surface. In this paper, we study the impact of bulk and the surface contributions on the total dark current. We demonstrate that the Ge-film/doped contact interface can be modified to reduce dark currents, which provides an additional option in the design of photodetectors with low leakage current. The modification at this interface not only leads to the reduction in the bulk leakage, but surface leakage component as well.

articleTitle: Energy-efficient coherent supercontinuum generation in silicon
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Stimulated supercontinuum generation via coherent seeding is numerically demonstrated to produce continua of broader bandwidth and higher coherence than the conventional unseeded case. Implications for energy efficient generation of WDM channels are discussed.

articleTitle: High efficiency grating couplers based on CMOS poly-silicon gate layer
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Grating couplers using CMOS poly-silicon gate layer are demonstrated, which can be integrated with electronic circuits without adding any additional process steps. Peak coupling efficiency of ~40% and 3dB bandwidth of ~60nm are obtained with low back reflection.

articleTitle: Vertertical integration of silicon nitride on siliconon-insulator platform
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We propose to integrate silicon nitride on silicon-on-insulator platform for devices which require low insertion loss and high power handling capability. Preliminary results including silicon nitride growth, high-Q resonator fabrication, and vertical integration are presented.

articleTitle: Light emission from thulium silicates for optical amplifiers on silicon in extended optical communication bands
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Tm<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sub> grown on silicon was characterized by synchrotron grazing incidence X-ray diffraction and micro photoluminescence/Raman spectroscopy. Tm<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sub> has luminescence at about 1620 nm, indicating its potential as a light amplifier in the L- and U-bands.

articleTitle: Photonic nanostructure Tx/Rx devices for advanced optical networks
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Photonic crystal and Si photonics components are integrated by using CMOS-compatible process. High-speed, compact, and functional Tx/Rx devices are possible thanks to the enhanced light-matter interaction and tunable delay of slow light.

articleTitle: Sub-fF nanophotodetector for efficient waveguide integration
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We simulate a 33% quantum efficiency, 240 aF germanium photodiode coupled directly to a silicon waveguide. The variation of geometric parameters barely degrades the performance, showing promise for future fabrication.

articleTitle: Bit-error rate improvement through all-optical signal regeneration in deposited silicon waveguides
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We demonstrate all-optical signal regeneration using a Mamyshev design in a hydrogenated amorphous silicon (a-Si:H) waveguide. Bit-error-rate improvement of 2 dB is achieved with 5.2 W peak power at telecommunication data rates (10 GHz).

articleTitle: Designing short tapered waveguide adapters for Ge lasers and Ge/SiGe modulators integrated with SOI waveguides
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We study optical mode propagation in vertically-coupled lateral tapers, which act as mode adapters between SOI waveguides and epitaxial Ge or SiGe layers for applications in laser cavities and optical modulators. We find that the taper length at which the loss tends to zero is strongly dependent on the thickness of the epitaxial layer, and we describe designs for modified tapers, which act as efficient mode adapters and are significantly shorter than linear tapers.

articleTitle: Large transient optical gain from N+ Ge-on-Si
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We report a large transient optical gain of ~1000 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> from n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> Ge-on-Si at λ=1645 nm using femtosecond pump-probe spectroscopy. The gain spectrum width is 70 nm, from 1610 to 1680 nm.

articleTitle: Single trench waveguide TE-TM mode converter fabricated with SiON
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: A TE-TM mode converter constructed with a single trench SiON waveguide is described. The device is fabricated in a single mask and etching process. TE-TM mode conversion efficiency of 97% has been achieved.

articleTitle: Heralded single photons from silicon coupled-resonator optical waveguides
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We leverage the high spontaneous four-wave-mixing nonlinearity (γ≈4150/W·m) of silicon coupled-resonator optical waveguides to demonstrate a telecommunications-band, heralded single photon source. The generated light is antibunched with g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup>(0) ≈ 0.19 ±0.03 at low power.

articleTitle: Carbon nanotube photonics on silicon
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We report on luminescence and optical gain in carbon nanotubes at a wavelength of 1.3 μm and on the integration of carbon nanotube properties into silicon waveguide to develop a new class of optoelectronic devices.

articleTitle: Accurate chromatic dispersion characterization of nanophotonic waveguides with thermal phase noise cancellation
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We report an experimental technique for accurate characterization of chromatic dispersion and its slope versus wavelength. The system consists of a fiber-based heterodyne Mach-Zehnder interferometer with a counter-propagating beam which is used to cancel the thermal phase noise. Three different silicon-based waveguides are characterized, obtaining a good agreement with theoretical simulations.

articleTitle: Silicon PIN quasi-continuous wave Terahertz emitter
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Enhanced external efficiency, improved coherence and tunability are demonstrated for silicon PIN THz emitters by utilizing the internal reflection and multi optical pulse excitation.

articleTitle: Tuning the electroluminescence of n-Ge LEDs using process induced strain
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: LEDs are reported from Ge-on-Si in which process induced strain has increased the emission wavelength. The direct bandgap electroluminescence emits up to ~ μW of power between 1.6 μm and ~1.8 μm, significantly larger than previous LEDs.

articleTitle: Plasma deposited µc-Si:H wire waveguide
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: A plasma deposited μc-Si:H film containing 10 nm sized crystallites was used to fabricate a wire waveguide. Despite present higher propagation losses: 6.5 dB/cm (TE) and 4.7 dB/cm (TM), it should exhibit an improved photostability.

articleTitle: Small dimension hybrid SPP waveguide with low propagation loss
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Hybrid surface plasmon polariton waveguide was fabricated, which has a dimension about 500 nm×575 nm. The visible scattering light covers the whole 4.5-mm-long Au strip. A propagation loss of 20 dB/cm was experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Vertical-tunneling spot-size converters for silicon-wire waveguides
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: A new spot-size converter utilizing tunneling phenomenon in the vertical direction for coupling between a silicon-wire waveguide and a single-mode fiber is proposed. Numerical calculations predict a miniaturized spot-size converter shorter than 50μm.

articleTitle: High-speed GeSi EA modulator at 1550 nm
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We demonstrate a high speed GeSi EA modulator with a broad operating wavelength range of over 30 nm near 1550 nm and a 3 dB bandwidth of 40.7 GHz at 2.8 V reverse bias.

articleTitle: The improvement effect of carrier injection by Ag nanoparticles on the electroluminescence of SiNx-based LEDs
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: The injection of carriers for SiN<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>-based light-emitting devices (LEDs) is improved by the addition of silver nanoparticels (Ag NPs) onto the luminescence matrix. The threshold voltage of the device and the turn-on voltage for thermal emission of carriers are decreased. No visible electroluminescence (EL) from SiN<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>-based LEDs can be detected under the Poole-Frenkel transport of carriers. This EL can be resolved when the transport of carriers along their corresponding band tails is dominated under a higher voltage. The turn-on voltage of EL is decreased significantly by the addition of Ag NPs due to this improved carrier injections.

articleTitle: High capacity, photo-trimmable athermal silicon waveguides
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Sandwiching a photosensitive layer of As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> between Si core and polymer cladding enables trimming of athermal waveguides. Moreover, athermal operation enables the compensation of thermal effects related to Si nonlinearity with respect to standard waveguides.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared As2Se3 chalcogenide glass-on-silicon waveguides
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We report the fabrication and characterization of high-index-contrast As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s</sub>Se<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> chalcogenide glass waveguides on silicon. Guided mode optical transmission are measured at 5.27 μm mid-infrared wavelength with low optical loss.

articleTitle: Si-ncs size distribution induced inhomogeneous linewidth broadening and lifetime dispersion
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: The correlation between size-dependent radiative lifetime dispersion and inhomogeneous broadening of Si-ncs has been first characterized by decomposing the stretch exponential decay trace of Si-nc-related luminescence through the zero-phonon assisted recombination model.

articleTitle: Polarization-entangled photon pair source on a chip
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We present a polarization-entanglement source integrated on a chip. The device consists of two nonlinear silicon wire waveguides connected by a silicon-wire polarization rotator. A maximally entangled state was obtained with a fidelity of 91%.

articleTitle: Sub-100 µm, 40 Gb/s photonic crystal silicon optical modulators
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We demonstrate a 90 μm, 40 Gb/s silicon MZI modulator, exploiting large group index (>;30) slow-light photonic crystal phase-shifters at 5.3 Vpp drive voltage. We also demonstrate a 50 μm device with 12.5 nm bandwidth.

articleTitle: Compact silicon differential receiver with integrated zero biased balanced detection
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We present an optimized differential receiver in silicon with a minimized footprint and balanced zero biased Ge photodiodes. The receiver integrates a delay-line with a 2×4 MMI 90 degree hybrid and two balanced photo diodes for DQPSK demodulation. Also a tunable power splitter is included for better balancing. Two receivers were tested, for 10Gbps and 20Gbps operation, and well opened eye-diagrams were measured.

articleTitle: Photonic Crystal Cavity Based WDM Components
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a simple but efficient WDM architecture using photonic crystal cavities.

articleTitle: Photothermal optical switching in ultra-compact hybrid Si-VO2 ring resonators
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We demonstrate optical switching in ultra-compact hybrid Si-VO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> ring resonators. Large changes in resonant wavelength and optical transmission are achieved by photothermally triggering the reversible semiconductor-to-metal phase-transition of VO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>.

articleTitle: 1.55 µm electroluminescence from strained n-Ge quantum wells on silicon substrates
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Electroluminescence from strained n-Ge quantum wells LEDs on Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.05</sub>Ge<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.95</sub> are demonstrated. Electroluminescence characterisation demonstrates two peaks around 1.55 μm and 1.8 μm, which correspond to transitions between the direct and indirect transitions respectively.

articleTitle: Welcome
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Welcome to the 9<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics, San Diego 2012. This conference series began in Hong Kong in 2004, and has been hosted in rotation in Europe, North America and Asia. The conference now returns to North America. We are delighted to see a steady number of submissions, and we are expecting a steady increase in participation from all parts of the world.

articleTitle: Table of contents
publicationTitle: The 9th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: silicon waveguides; design and process optimisation; photodiodes; photodetectors; light emission; transceivers; modulators; integrated optics; photonic crystals.
